title: SurfPatch
description: Creates a patch of surface formed by nodes in a nodefile and optionally calculates the volume between the same patch on two isotopic surfaces.

nodefile.description: File containing nodes defining the patch
nodefile.title: Node File

inode.description: Index of the column containing the nodes
inode.title: Node Column Index

ilabel.description: Index of the column containing labels of the nodes in column inode
ilabel.title: Label Column Index

hits.description: Minimum number of nodes specified for a triangle to be made a part of the patch (1 <= min_hits <= 3); default is 2
hits.title: Minimum Hits

masklabel.description: Only nodes that are labeled with this label are considered for the patch
masklabel.title: Mask Label

vol.description: Calculate the volume formed by the patch on surf_A and surf_B. Requires only two surfaces specified with surf_A and surf_B.
vol.title: Calculate Volume

vol_only.description: Only calculate the volume, don't write out patches.
vol_only.title: Volume Only

patch2surf.description: Turn surface patch into a surface where only nodes used in forming the mesh are preserved.
patch2surf.title: Patch to Surface

coord_gain.description: Multiply node coordinates by a gain. Useful for enlarging tiny patches for easier viewing in SUMA.
coord_gain.title: Coordinate Gain

check_bowtie.description: Check if the patch has a section hanging by one node to the rest of the mesh. Default when -vol or -vol_only are used.
check_bowtie.title: Check Bowtie

ok_bowtie.description: Do not check for, or fix bowties. Default when -vol* are not used.
ok_bowtie.title: OK Bowtie

adjust_contour.description: Shrink patch contours at nodes that were not in nodefile.
adjust_contour.title: Adjust Contour

do_not_adjust_contour.description: Do not adjust contours. This is the default.
do_not_adjust_contour.title: Do Not Adjust Contour

stitched_surface.description: Write out the stitched surface used to calculate the volume.
stitched_surface.title: Stitched Surface

flip_orientation.description: Change orientation of triangles before writing surfaces.
flip_orientation.title: Flip Orientation

verbosity.description: Set verbosity level, 1 is the default.
verbosity.title: Verbosity Level
